highlights: CERD opened its 118th session in Geneva (10-25 Aug 2026), reviewing Kuwait, India, Honduras and Finland under ICERD (182 States parties); concluding observations due 25 Aug 2026.
ECtHR Grand Chamber will deliver its judgment in Kavala v. Türkiye (no. 2) on 25 Aug 2026, 10:00 Strasbourg; judgment adopted 2 Jul 2026, final and binding on delivery.
CRPD gap: 185 of 193 UN Member States have ratified the Convention, but only 100 have ratified the Optional Protocol enabling individual complaints.
